config.content:
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: Clean Example API
  version: 1.0.0
servers:
  - url: https://api.example.test
security:
  - bearerAuth: []
paths:
  /api/widgets:
    get:
      summary: List widgets
      parameters:
        - name: callback_url
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Widget page
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/WidgetPage"
  /api/widgets/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Fetch one widget
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        "200":
          description: One widget
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Widget"
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
  schemas:
    Widget:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
        name:
          type: string
    WidgetPage:
      type: object
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Widget"
        total:
          type: integer
